input: Summarize the pit gain event in today's drilling report: was the well shut in and what did the flow check show?
context: Daily Drilling Report, Well A-12, Day 14: Drilled from 9,850 ft to 10,240 ft. Mud weight held at 11.2 ppg. A 6 bbl pit gain was observed at 10,180 ft; the well was shut in and a flow check was negative. Drilling resumed after 2 hours.

input: What was the footage drilled and current depth?
context: Daily Drilling Report, Well B-03, Day 9: Start depth 7,400 ft. End depth 8,050 ft. Footage drilled 650 ft. Average rate of penetration 54 ft/hr. Next operation is to run 9-5/8 in casing.

input: Were there any safety incidents in the last 24 hours?
context: Daily Drilling Report, Well C-21, Day 5: HSE: One first aid case, a hand laceration during pipe handling; the crew held a safety stand-down. Zero lost time incidents. Two JSAs reviewed for the casing job.

input: How many hours of NPT were recorded today and what was the cause?
context: Daily Drilling Report, Well A-07, Day 11: Total NPT 3.5 hours. Cause: top drive hydraulic leak, repaired by rig mechanic. Remaining 20.5 hours were productive drilling and connections.

input: What is the planned next operation and any open risks?
context: Daily Drilling Report, Well D-02, Day 18: Current operation circulating bottoms up at 12,300 ft. Plan: pull out of hole to change bit. Open risk: tight hole noted at 11,900 ft on last trip; ream if overpull exceeds 30 klbs.

input: What does the procedure say before starting hot work near the wellhead?
context: HSE Procedure HW-02: Hot work within 35 ft of the wellhead requires a hot work permit signed by the rig manager. Continuous gas monitoring must show 0% LEL before and during the work. A fire watch remains for 30 minutes after the work ends.
